name: zc_exposure

tests.name: the world is not clipping large parts of the frame to white

detail.note: pixels at 250+ have lost their detail permanently; 2% is the bar

tests.name: a mascot skin filling the frame is not blown out

detail.note: the founder's own words: the skins must be clearly visible

tests.name: a companion is not blown out either

detail.note: named in the same breath as the skins; unmeasured if no standalone companion is present

tests.name: and the picture has not simply been made dark instead

detail.note: guards the fix: reducing glare by underexposing everything would pass E01 and be worse
